sections.content: The workflow repair defines slices W0 through W6 for typed source selection, deterministic transport, adapter-owned coverage, independent Knowledge gates, immutable generation pointers, retention, and end-to-end validation. Acceptance preserves authority ownership and does not publish Knowledge authority.
sections.title: Implementation contract

sections.content: Sources require complete typed selection, deterministic paged transfer, observed coverage, controlled Knowledge continuation or refresh, validated immutable receipts, protected retention, and a non-authorizing end-to-end route. Missing, conflicting, stale, or drifting inputs remain blocked or require controlled repair.
sections.title: Requirements

sections.content: The supplied modules provide Knowledge gate projection, coverage evaluation, generation publication, current-pointer resolution, retention planning, transport planning, and tests covering missing or duplicate pages, source drift, immutable generation behavior, approval-gated retention, transport identity, and typed selection.
